description: Guard (016 T014m, round-4 review F2: container markers). A list item opens a div block; the opener inside it has no closer before the blank line, and raw HTML passes through, so the browser's comment hides the marker after it. The digest on disk carries only the visible rule, so the check must say OK; harvesting the hidden marker would call this correct digest stale. Without the container markers in the block-start test, the div is missed and the marker harvested. Since 016 phase 2 (plan D8 and D11 as amended during phase 2) the marker passed over inside the comment is also reported by DIGEST-020, so the run fails naming its line; a mutation that harvests it drops that report and reads the digest stale.
